# Health, Safety, Employee & Labor Relations Features | Sodales

Explore Sodales Platform Features for Health, Safety and Employee & Labor Relations Compliance
Discover the only all-in-one AI-enabled platform to bring health, safety, employee and labor relations features under one roof, to safeguard your most valuable asset — your people.
Employee & Labor Relations
Avoid union strikes, prevent complaints and grievances and enhance overall organizational productivity with streamlined workflow processes that facilitate proactive implementation of fair actions and consistent policy interpretation throughout your organization. Sodales ensures compliance with government regulations and contractual requirements, including CBA’s, work rules and attendance policies, revolutionizing your processes with advanced software boasting mobile compatibility and offline app functionality, enabling your organization to adeptly navigate employee and labor dynamics from anywhere.
Grievances, Arbitration, Time Claims & CBA Management
Simplify complex grievances, time claims and collective bargaining agreement (CBA) administration when managing matters across multiple unions, including loss of pay, job accommodations, time lost and more. Built to support both day-to-day operations and long-term strategy, centralize grievance documentation, automate timelines and integrate directly with CBA contracts to ensure actions are consistent with union agreements. Get a single source of truth for grievance resolution, cost tracking, CBA rule simulation and collaborative decision-making.
Key Capabilities:
- Track and resolve individual, group and policy grievances, including those related to time claims, with smart automation tools that support union-specific delay rules, duplicate existing grievance details, auto-generate step responses based on deadlines and revise responses to prevent unnecessary escalations
- Manage multi-union CBAs with unique grievance rules to follow protocols and timelines per union agreement
- Centralized repository with keyword search across CBAs, HR policies, appeals and grievance case files
- Schedule grievance hearings, meetings and arbitration sessions with Outlook integration
- Standardize grievance responses with pre-built templates and self-service access documentation and status updates
- View each employee’s grievance history for context, trend analysis and informed case handling
- Detect recurring grievance trends and identify problematic policies using AI-enabled analytics and dashboards
- Test the impact of proposed CBA changes before implementation using simulation tools
- Seamlessly connect with Sodales discipline and CBA management modules to enable holistic oversight and case-to-contract alignment
- Enforce jurisprudence by tracking financial liability in real time and guiding each case through a standardized step-by-step workflow, with the flexibility to escalate when necessary to maintain fairness and compliance
- Protect sensitive data with role-based permissions, automated notifications and secure electronic signatures
Discipline Management
Effectively manage employee conduct and maintain a consistent disciplinary process. Whether addressing progressive infractions, serious misconduct or implementing positive discipline strategies, act confidently with features to support policy and compliance. Built for both unionized and non-unionized environments, use a centralized hub to manage discipline levels, reference CBA terms and apply mitigating or aggravating factors, all while ensuring transparency, traceability and fairness in every case.
Key Capabilities:
- Create, track and resolve disciplinary cases, from positive discipline to progressive infractions and serious misconduct, while managing the entire lifecycle, including safety discussions, corrective action progress and duration adjustments, with clear documentation at every stage
- Leverage embedded investigation tools to ensure every case is handled thoroughly and in alignment with policy and compliance standards
- Store and access all discipline-related documents, including contracts, CBAs and rulebooks, with advanced keyword search for quick referencing
- Automatically link related records, including incident reports, investigation results and grievances, to maintain full historical context of each discipline. Intelligent workflows recommend appropriate discipline levels and escalate actions based on prior or pending disciplinary history
- Track and apply progressive discipline levels alongside mitigating and aggravating factors
- Utilize configurable discipline letter templates to maintain clarity and consistency across all written communications
- Instantly view an employee’s disciplinary history to guide current decisions and maintain compliance with policy or union requirements
- Seamlessly connect with grievance and CBA management modules to ensure alignment across labor relations processes and enable end-to-end traceability
- Protect sensitive data with role-based permissions, automated notifications and secure electronic signatures
Union Job Bidding
Simplify and streamline internal job postings to support complex union job bidding environments with full lifecycle functionality. From role-based job posting creation to bid evaluations and seniority-driven awards, ensure fair, transparent and compliant workforce mobility.
Key Capabilities:
- Create and manage postings based on job type (departmental, temporary, permanent, etc.) with configurable templates and role-based permissions
- Include built-in approval workflows to ensure postings are reviewed and authorized before going live
- Support multi-bidding and mass-bidding scenarios with Bid Sheets, having options for employees to apply or withdraw bids or accept or decline awards, either on their own behalf or via proxy
- Enable bid-lock capabilities to maintain control over employee participation in active postings and applications
- Automatically calculate and rank bids by seniority requirements and generate award letters with preloaded templates and support concurrent employment scenarios
- Manage employee eligibility with built-in rules that restrict bidding based on active disciplines, grievances or investigations. Support bumping flows, manual assignment of unplaced employees and bid cancellations, ensuring job movement follows CBAs and procedural timelines
- Streamline high-volume job movements with tools for managing position sign-ups, resulting vacancies, job accommodations and training requirements. Automate job posting statuses, enable bid calendars for future visibility and ensure complete lifecycle tracking from award to probation
- Adapt dynamically with flexible workflows that support both automated and manual updates to employee positions, including pre-bid submissions and real-time adjustments driven by bidding or bumping outcomes
- Eligibility check library to ensure qualified employees can bid based on union rules, job level, licenses etc.
- Access complete bid history through a job application portal, including posting type, outcome and any linked grievances or disputes for a full view of the process
- Trigger real-time notifications for approvals, awards or updates
- Protect sensitive data with role-based permissions and secure electronic signatures

Workforce Risk Intelligence
Key Capabilities:
- Brings together data from health, safety, labor relations, and employee relations so organizations can understand how different risk factors connect and influence outcomes.
